newsitem.title: USA: Public Storage units to merge.
newsitem.headline: Public Storage units to merge.

text.p: Public Storage Inc said Wednesday it agreed to separate mergers with Public Storage Properties XIX Inc and Public Storage Properties XVII Inc.

In ther merger with Public Storage Properties XIX Inc, each of that company's common shares will be converted into either shares of Public Storage Inc or $16.72 in cash, their estimated net asset value.
Each share of Public Storage Properties XVII Inc will be converted into either Public Storage Inc shares or $19.63 in cash.

In addition, Public Storage Properties XV Inc said its shareholders approved the plan of reorganization that would merge it with Public Storage Inc. The merger is expected to be completed on April 11.
